title: Buried channels point the way to solid state imager

passages.locator: 22 May, pp. 29 and 31, Going through channels and photograph
passages.note: The trade report documents a Fairchild Palo Alto laboratory 500-element buried-channel linear sensor with a central photosensing strip, two shielded 250-stage readout registers, and a camera image. It distinguishes the Fairchild and Bell Labs programs.
